subject: Credentials playbook & invite plan for Pegasus Health
messages:
From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.inference>
To: Alex Chang <alex.chang@pegasushealth.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.inference>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.inference>
Date: Fri, 27 Nov 2026 09:02:00 -0800
Subject: Credentials playbook & invite plan for Pegasus Health

Alex —

Great to connect earlier. This thread will be the working thread for the initial workspace setup and credentialing handoff so we have a single source of truth. Per our discovery, next steps we plan to execute over the next 7 business days are: 

1) Create the project/namespace (pegasus-prod) and seed one temporary developer API key for your dev team.
2) Seed an admin service account for SSO onboarding and one read-only key for integrations testing.
3) Invite initial admin users (list needed from you).
4) Collect SAML metadata and identify IdP contact for SSO test.
5) Confirm rotation policy and CIP for API keys (we recommend 7-day temp keys, 90-day service keys).

I've attached a short checklist to map owners for each step (pegasus_onboard_checklist.xlsx). To keep the rollout low-risk, we propose the following timeline:

- Day 0 (today): confirm admin list + upload SAML metadata
- Day 1: seed sandbox dev key, create project/namespace
- Day 2–3: SSO test with your IdP contact, invite admins
- Day 4–7: finalize production keys, rotate, handoff documentation

Questions for you to unblock us:
- Please send the canonical list of admin emails (comma-separated) and which user should be the initial SSO contact.
- Do you want the seeded dev key to be scoped for query-only (recommended) or full generate?

Suggested invite matrix (we can adjust):
- Admins: full workspace + billing visibility
- Integrations: service account (no console access)
- Developers: project-level keys, read/generate per app scope

I'll tentatively schedule a 30-minute kickoff for today or early next week — can you confirm availability?

Thanks,
Jonas Weber
Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
[jonas.weber@redwood.inference]

---
Attachment: pegasus_onboard_checklist.xlsx (spreadsheet, 12KB)
From: Alex Chang <alex.chang@pegasushealth.com>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.inference>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.inference>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.inference>
Date: Fri, 27 Nov 2026 10:18:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Credentials playbook & invite plan for Pegasus Health

Jonas —

Thanks, this looks good and matches what we discussed. Quick answers:

- Admin list (initial): Sara Liu <sara.liu@pegasushealth.com>, Michael Denton <michael.denton@pegasushealth.com>. Sara will be the IdP contact.
- For the dev key: please scope it to query-only for now — developers only need embedding/lookup traffic.
- We'll attach our SAML metadata to this thread (sending IT a copy). Our IT team will also confirm certificate rotation timing.

I've looped in our IT alias (it_support@pegasushealth.com) and Sara. Sara will send the SAML metadata and an engineer for the SSO test — they'll likely prefer a morning slot PST.

One ask: can you seed a non-console service account with a short token so our integration test harness can run against the sandbox? If yes, what scopes do you recommend for that account?

Appreciate it — we are aiming to start testing on Monday morning.

Best,
Alex
Director of Platform Engineering
Pegasus Health

---
Attachment: pegasus_saml_metadata.xml (xml, 3KB)
From: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.inference>
To: Alex Chang <alex.chang@pegasushealth.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.inference>
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.inference>
Date: Fri, 27 Nov 2026 11:45:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Credentials playbook & invite plan for Pegasus Health

Alex / team —

Thanks for the quick reply and for confirming Sara and Michael. For the non-console service account used by your test harness, we recommend the following scopes: 

- embeddings.read, embeddings.create (if you need embedding generation)
- models.list (to verify available models programmatically)
- usage.read (to validate token limits during tests)

We will seed a sandbox service account token scoped to embeddings.read, models.list and set an expiry of 7 days. After you validate, we can promote a production service account with a 90-day rotation policy.

Action items we will take this morning:
- Jonas will create the pegagus-dev project namespace and seed a dev API key (query-only).
- I will prepare the invite CSV (redwood-invite-template.csv) and a short how-to for rotating keys via the Console.

Alex: please confirm the exact email addresses (Sara/Michael are good) and any other users that should be part of the initial admin group by end of day. Also let us know preferred kickoff windows for next week (Mon/Tue mornings PST are fine for us).

Monica Patel
Customer Success Manager | Redwood Inference
monica.patel@redwood.inference

---
Attachment: redwood-invite-template.csv (csv, 1KB)
From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.inference>

Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.inference>
Date: Fri, 27 Nov 2026 14:35:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Credentials playbook & invite plan for Pegasus Health

Quick update — I'm handing off the provisioning tasks to the infra runbook and have completed the sandbox scaffolding: 

- Namespace created: pegasus-dev (project id: pegasus-20261127)
- Dev API key (query-only) seeded and shared to your IT alias via secure link (will expire in 7 days).
- Sandbox service account token (embeddings.read, models.list) created and attached to the test harness with a 7-day expiry.

Next steps for your team:
- Confirm Sara and Michael's final emails for admin invites (respond inline).
- IT to coordinate SSO test window — Sara, please propose 2 windows tomorrow morning PST.
- Alex: confirm if the integration test harness needs generate rights later this week and we will scope accordingly.

I'll bring this into the kickoff meeting notes and share the meeting invite (link below). If anything is urgent, ping me directly.

Thanks,
Jonas
Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
